html:
The independence of Montenegro was recognised by the great powers at the Congress of Berlin on 13 July 1878, after Montenegro fought beside Russia and Serbia in the war against the Ottomans.

Under Prince Nicholas the small principality had won battles in 1876 and 1877. At Berlin it almost doubled its land and gained the port of Bar, its first outlet to the sea, along with Podgorica and Nikšić. Cetinje filled with foreign embassies. Nicholas made the state a kingdom in 1910, and it fought in the Balkan Wars. It lost its independence in 1918 to the new Yugoslav kingdom, and regained it only in 2006.
